comments.author: Todd Dailey
comments.comment: The real risk in air-gapped local RAG is not model quality, it's stale chunks and duplicate docs. For this stack, are you measuring doc recall first, then task success, or going straight to eval on the final reports? #LocalAI #RAG #Eval

comments.author: Roy Derks
comments.comment:
The 81.1 vs 46.7 gap looks like harness engineering, not model magic: step decomposition, tool routing, sandboxing, and verification can rescue weak open-weight agents. I’d want the task split for CUGA vs Hermes, especially how many needed runtime policy enforcement vs simple tool selection. Which harness component would you test first?
#AgenticAI #LLMEvals #AIEngineering

comments.author: Jason Toews
comments.comment: At 700 commits a day, manual review becomes theater. The real win is turning trust into a deterministic merge gate with tests, worktrees, and a queue. When tests pass but architecture drifts, what signal stops the merge? #AgenticAI #Testing

comments.author: Hammad Shaukat
comments.comment: At 7x token burn, eval cost becomes the real blocker. I’d rather run a cheap eval model on every agent interaction than sample 1% with a commercial LLM. Are you checking every trace, or still sampling? #AgenticAI #Evals #AIObservability
